scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Merit Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: For incoming college freshmen who wish to pursue science and technology courses. Covers full tuition and provides monthly stipend for living expenses.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition + PHP 7,000 monthly stipend + book allowance

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI RA 7687 Scholarship
scholarships.description: Under Republic Act 7687, this scholarship is for students from poor but deserving families who wish to pursue science and technology-related courses.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition + PHP 6,000 monthly stipend + miscellaneous fees

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI ASTHRDP Graduate Scholarship
scholarships.description: Accelerated Science and Technology Human Resource Development Program for graduate students conducting thesis or dissertation research in S&T fields.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 20,000 thesis grant + PHP 9,000 monthly stipend

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Capacity Building Program for S&T
scholarships.description: For students enrolled in science and technology undergraduate programs in recognized universities. Aimed at building the country's S&T human resource base.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 12,000 per semester + PHP 5,000 equipment allowance

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Engineering Research and Development Scholarship
scholarships.description: For students taking engineering and technology courses with demonstrated interest in research and innovation under the Philippine S&T development roadmap.
scholarships.benefits: Full tuition + PHP 8,500 monthly stipend + research grant

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Junior Level Science Scholarship
scholarships.description: For second year students excelling in natural sciences and mathematics. Designed to retain talented S&T students who are at risk of shifting courses due to financial constraints.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 10,000 per semester + PHP 4,000 laboratory allowance

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Agriculture and Fisheries Scholarship
scholarships.description: For students pursuing degrees in Agriculture, Fisheries, and related fields. Supports food security goals and modernization of the Philippine agriculture sector.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 11,000 per semester + farm tools allowance

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Environmental Science Grant
scholarships.description: For third year students majoring in Environmental Science, Ecology, or related disciplines. Aligned with the national climate change adaptation and environmental protection agenda.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 13,000 per semester + field research allowance

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Mathematics and Statistics Scholarship
scholarships.description: For students enrolled in BS Mathematics, Statistics, or Applied Mathematics programs. Supports development of quantitative talent needed in data-driven industries.
scholarships.benefits: PHP 11,000 per semester + software license allowance

scholarships.title: DOST-SEI Balik Scientist Incentive Program
scholarships.description: For graduating students with outstanding academic records who commit to working in Philippine S&T institutions after completing advanced studies abroad.
scholarships.benefits: Full graduate tuition abroad + monthly living allowance + airfare
